dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Moderate, symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the visible posterior region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse clusters of darker grey pigment distributed across the anterior and mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope observed between the pigmented mottling and the light grey baseline canvas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, faint linear marks on the central dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible faint linear scratches or rake marks across the dorsal surface.
